data.summary: gates.toml has two roles that conflict: it is the ONLY supported place to declare human=true gates and pipeline overrides (configwrite.py:289, README), yet this repo git-ignores it as machine-local (D-no-own-services-committed, for worker counts) -- a human checkpoint declared there never reaches another clone. Machine sizing needs its own local layer (found by roborev on B-onboard-command)
